description: This file provides functions for creating audit logs related to LiteLLM Proxy operations. It includes asynchronous functions to create audit logs for object modifications and updates, interacting with a database and handling audit log data in JSON format.

methods.name: create_object_audit_log( object_id: str, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str], user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_proxy_admin_name: Optional[str], table_name: LitellmTableNames, before_value: Optional[str] = None, after_value: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an audit log entry for a specified object action, capturing details such as object ID, action type, user info, and before/after values, and stores it in the database if audit logging is enabled.

methods.name: create_audit_log_for_update(request_data: LiteLLM_AuditLogs)
methods.description: Asynchronously creates an audit log entry for an object update, verifying audit log storage is enabled and that the user has premium access, then logs the details into the database.
